# HighLevel API 2021-07-28: full reference

> Every endpoint of HighLevel API version 2021-07-28 (740 endpoints in 44 services). Compact reference generated from the OpenAPI specs: every endpoint lists what is needed to call it.

- Base URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com
- Send the header `Version: 2021-07-28` on every request.
- Send `Authorization: Bearer <token>` unless the endpoint says "Auth: none".
- Index of this version: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/llms/2021-07-28/llms.txt

- fromEmail string - Sender email address
- subjectLine string - Email subject line
- previewText string - Preview text
- previewUrl string - Preview URL
- createdAt string - Created timestamp
- updatedAt string - Updated timestamp
- traceId string - Trace ID of request

Errors: 400, 401, 403, 404, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 403 (The token does not have access to this location) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for invalid location access
- message string - Error message describing the location access failure
Response 404 (Not Found) application/json:
- statusCode number - HTTP status code for not found
- message string - Error message describing the not found failure
- error string - Error type identifier

### Create a new template
POST /emails/builder
URL: https://services.leadconnectorhq.com/emails/builder
Docs: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/emails/create-template | Markdown: https://marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs/2021-07-28/ghl/emails/create-template.md

DEPRECATED.

Auth: Sub-Account token: OAuth access token or Private Integration Token. Scopes: emails/builder.write

Headers:
- Authorization: Bearer <token> (required)
- Version: 2021-07-28 (required)

Request body (required) (application/json) CreateBuilderDto:
- locationId* string (e.g. "ve9EPM428h8vShlRW1KT")
- title string (e.g. "template title")
- type* string (enum: html | folder | import | builder | blank | ai_template | vibe-editor)
- updatedBy string (e.g. "zYy3YOUuHxgomU1uYJty")
- builderVersion string (enum: 1 | 2; default: 2)
- name string (e.g. "Template1")
- parentId string (e.g. "zYy3YOUuHxgomU1uYJty")
- templateDataUrl string (e.g. "")
- importProvider* string (enum: mailchimp | active_campaign | kajabi | other | import_with_email_ai)
- importURL string (e.g. "https://tplshare.com/fhYJ3Mi")
- templateSource string (e.g. "template_library")
- isPlainText boolean
- subjectLine string (e.g. "Email Subject")
- fromName string (e.g. "Name of sender")
- fromEmail string (e.g. "test@abc.com")
- previewText string (e.g. "preview text")

Response 201 (Success) application/json:
- redirect* string - template id
- traceId* string - trace id

Errors: 400, 401, 404, 422 (400, 401, 422: see Common error responses)
Response 404 (Not Found): no body
